en: Black‑and‑white divided-view postcard showing two separate wooden buildings. The left image depicts a large Protestant-style church with a tall square tower topped by a steep spire and finial, louvered belfry openings, and a broad gabled nave; there is a raised entrance with steps and a porch, and stained-glass windows visible in the entry. The right image shows a substantial three-story institutional building, likely a school or town hall, with a prominent corner turret capped by a conical roof and finial, symmetrical facade, central stairway leading to a porch with pediment, and many tall sash windows. Both structures sit in lightly developed surroundings with grass and a few trees. The card margins are wide and white, with some retouching or paint obscuring the bottom edge. At the very bottom edge, upside down, there is a handwritten number and a brief word.
